hero.title: Livestock Stations
hero.lead: A network of stations dedicated to rearing, managing and applied research on reference herds, including sheep production.

intro.title: Field support for veterinary research
intro.text: The IIV's livestock stations maintain reference herds under controlled conditions, supporting field trials, livestock production and direct support to the institute's laboratories. Detailed information for each station — location, herd numbers and ongoing programmes — is being consolidated and will be published on this page as it is confirmed.
